instruction.text: Dohyun has 17 beetles, but 7 beetles run away. How many beetles does Dohyun have left.
Freya has 9 blue marbles and 16 green marbles. How many marbles does Freya have altogether.
Ramona has 18 cards, and her sister takes 5 of them. How many cards does Ramona have left.
Iris has 9 white sprinkles and 11 purple sprinkles. How many sprinkles does Iris have altogether.
Niran has 35 magnets and gives 6 magnets to his friend. How many magnets does Niran have left.
Elijah has 16 red cars and 12 silver cars. How many cars does Elijah have altogether.
Lucia has 8 pink bobbles and 13 orange bobbles. How many bobbles does Lucia have altogether.
Casper has 16 pens and gives 7 pens to his brother. How many pens does Casper have left.
